description: Country everyday reference: name, name_full, name_local, demonym, iso_alpha3 and iso_numeric identifiers, continent, region and subregion, currency, languages, calling code, flag, timezones, borders, bloc memberships, capital object (name, latitude, longitude), postal_format guidance and postal_regex syntax checking on every plan. Postal patterns do not establish assignment or deliverability. Paid plans automatically include population, total area and national statistics (gdp_usd, gdp_per_capita_usd, population_growth_percent, urban_population_percent and internet_users_percent), geography including elevation_average in meters, and a tax reference object (name, rate) and locale conventions. Unknown values stay null.

code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. US

deep.description: Compatibility flag; paid plans include this profile detail automatically.

lang.description: Optional display language, such as fr or zh-Hant. IDs, numeric values and input parsing stay unchanged.
